{"metadata":{"description":"一个适用于deepseek-harness的插件，功能是显示当前账户余额以及当前会话预估的费用消耗 | A plugin for deepseek-harness that displays the current account balance and the estimated cost consumption of the current session.","id":"gh:1334317887","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-balance","slug":"LemCAE/dsh-balance","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"一个适用于deepseek-harness的插件，功能是显示当前账户余额以及当前会话预估的费用消耗 | A plugin for deepseek-harness that displays the "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"current account balance and the estimated cost consumption of the current session."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-balance"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A Host + Web Client composition plugin for deepseek-harness
(`dsh`): queries the DeepSeek Open Platf"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"orm account balance and estimates the
current session's spend. Installable via `dsh plugin add`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Balance**: queries the official `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`
using the harness's "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"own `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential (the key travels only
over a bounded node subprocess's stdin — nev"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"er in command lines, logs, or UI).
- **Session spend estimate**: folds the provider-reported token u"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"sage from the
session log (uncached input / cache-hit input / output) and prices each step
with the "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"official peak/off-peak table (peak 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00
Beijing time). **Estimate only — the o"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"fficial bill is authoritative.**
- **Top-bar chip** (session header): `余额 ¥x | 会话 ≈¥y`, click to ref"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"resh;
hover (500 ms) shows a detail tooltip **below the button**, horizontally
centered and viewport"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"-clamped.
- **Settings page** (设置 → DeepSeek 余额): balance rows, an auto-refresh
on/off switch, refre"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"sh-interval selector (15 s … 5 min or custom),
UI-language selector (`auto` follows the host UI / 中文"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" / English),
and an editable price table (off-peak / peak per model).
Changes persist in the setting"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"s document across restarts.
- **Model tool**: `deepseek_balance` returns balance + the calling sessi"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"on's
estimated spend.
- **Pause-aware refresh**: after 2 refresh cycles without a new user or
assist"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"ant message the auto-refresh pauses (5-minute detection cadence); it
resumes when a new conversation"},{"id":"p6s14","text":" appears. Auto-refresh can also be switched
off manually (Settings switch or `/dsh-balance auto-refr"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"esh off`); while
off, no queries are issued.
- **Self-contained**: no host-repository changes are re"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"quired to deploy
(communication rides the built-in `commands` Remote namespace)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Standard (bundle install, recommended):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The installer adds the package to the web profile's dependencies and bundle
list; after restarting `"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"dsh web`, the loader applies the in-package
`cordis.patch.yml` automatically. Verify:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Open any session → the `余额 ¥x | 会话 ≈¥y` chip appears in the header with
a hover detail tooltip;
- "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"设置 → DeepSeek 余额 shows the full card (balance, interval, language, price table);
- Ask the model to "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"call the `deepseek_balance` tool."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Manual install (same mechanism, bypassing the installer): edit
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" — add `"@lemcae/dsh-balance": "<latest version>"` (as on npm) to `dependencies` and `"@lemcae/dsh-b"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"alance"` to the
`dsh.profile.bundles` array — then run `pnpm install` in that directory and
restart."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Peer dependencies are the official `@deepseek-ai/*` packages (`^0.1.0-rc.5`
line, covering rc.5 and "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"rc.6; `@deepseek-ai/cordis` ^4.0.1) plus `react`,
provided by the host."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Chip**: shows `余额 ¥x | 会话 ≈¥y`; click to refresh; hover for details
(breakdown, model, 更新于, refr"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"esh cadence / pause note).
- **Settings**: 设置 → DeepSeek 余额 — balance rows, 自动刷新间隔
(15 s … 5 min or "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"custom), 自动刷新开关, 界面语言 (auto / 中文 / English), price-table editor (保存 persists), peak-hours hint.
- **"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"Command** (also usable from the command palette): `/dsh-balance [refresh | interval <毫秒> | prices <J"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"SON> | language <auto|zh-CN|en> | auto-refresh <on|off>]`.
- **Tool**: `deepseek_balance` (no argume"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"| language <auto|zh-CN|en> | auto-refresh <on|off>]`.
- **Tool**: `deepseek_balance` (no arguments)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Settings namespace `dsh-balance`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Field                 | Default    | Meaning                                                      "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"                                                                |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `autoRefresh`       | `true`   | Enable/disable the auto-refresh timer (`/dsh-balance auto-refresh"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" on\|off`)                                                 |
| `refreshIntervalMs` | `30000`  | Acti"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ve auto-refresh interval (5 000–600 000 ms)                                                         "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"                    |
| `language`          | `auto`   | Plugin UI language:`auto` (follow host UI),"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" `zh-CN`, or `en`                                                           |
| `prices`            "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"| see source | `{ models: { deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, default } }`, each model `{ offPeak,"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" peak }` rates in CNY per 1M tokens |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Prices are picked by Beijing hour: `peak` for 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00,
`offPeak` otherwise."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Estimate vs. bill**: the spend is computed from the local session log and
may differ from the of"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ficial bill (provider-side caching policy, unlogged
requests, model renames, price changes). Edit th"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e price table in Settings to
keep it current.
- **Unknown models** are priced with the `default` ent"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ry (v4-flash rates).
- **Subagents** have their own session ids and are not included.
- **Compaction"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"**: a compacted session resets event seqs; the incremental fold
may keep pre-compaction totals (acce"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ptable for an estimate).
- **Session-log noise**: every auto-refresh runs a slash command, appending"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"
`command/run` + `command/done` events; pause-downshifting reduces this.
- **Pause recovery latency*"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"*: while paused, the client probes once per
`PAUSED_REFRESH_MS` (5 min); a new conversation resumes "},{"id":"p22s9","text":"the active cadence
at the next probe, so recovery can lag by up to that interval.
- Balance is cache"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"d 10 s; the tool and chip may share one API call per cycle."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Request context and condition"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The tool schema `deepseek_balance` (zero parameters) plus its description,
which states it queries t"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"he official balance endpoint with the harness
credential and returns the session spend estimate."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"#### Token effect"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Zero direct tokens; the tool result is data-dependent (payload with balance,
consumption, prices, id"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"t tokens; the tool result is data-dependent (payload with balance,
consumption, prices, idle state)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"#### KV Cache effect"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Prefix-stable: tool name, description, and schema are constant; the result
varies per call, which do"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"es not invalidate prefix reuse."}],"truncated":false}
